name: identity.producer_attr_preserved
probe: SELECT LogAttributes['producer.attr'] FROM lh018.otel_logs WHERE Body='identity-ws-a-log'

name: identity.raw_key_not_in_resource_attributes
probe: SELECT count() FROM lh018.otel_logs WHERE arrayStringConcat(mapValues(ResourceAttributes),' ') LIKE '%lh018-ws%'

name: identity.raw_key_not_in_record_attributes
probe: SELECT count() FROM lh018.otel_logs WHERE arrayStringConcat(mapValues(LogAttributes),' ') LIKE '%lh018-ws%'

name: identity.single_row_per_body
probe: SELECT count() FROM lh018.otel_logs WHERE Body IN ('identity-ws-a-log','identity-ws-b-log')

name: identity.trace_workspace
probe: SELECT ResourceAttributes['lighthouse.workspace_id'] FROM lh018.otel_traces WHERE SpanName='span/ok' AND ResourceAttributes['lighthouse.workspace_id'] != ''

name: identity.materialized_column
probe: SELECT ws_materialized FROM lh018.otel_logs WHERE Body='identity-ws-a-log'
